name: Four Seasons Scottsdale at Troon North
positioning: Adobe-style desert resort of casitas beside Pinnacle Peak in the Sonoran Desert, with golf privileges at Troon North
best_for: Travelers who want a Sonoran Desert resort with golf privileges nearby
Families, with a complimentary kids program and two-bedroom suites

facts.text: The resort is adjacent to Pinnacle Peak Park.
The architecture is adobe-style, designed to blend with the surrounding Sonoran Desert.
Talavera is the resort's signature restaurant, bringing a modern Spanish sensibility to the table.
Proof is a Classic American restaurant.
Onyx Bar & Lounge offers small plates and handcrafted cocktails.
Guests enjoy exclusive privileges at the Pinnacle and Monument courses, with complimentary shuttles to and from the resort.
The resort has four pickleball courts and two tennis courts.
The resort has a 24-hour fitness centre.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Casita Room has a gas-burning fireplace.
The Jerome Two-Bedroom Suite has a private spa pool on its patio.
The Jerome Two-Bedroom Suite has a fully equipped kitchen.
The complimentary Kids For All Seasons program is open daily for children ages 5 to 12.
The resort is pet-friendly and welcomes dogs and cats.
The Nopal Massage is the spa's signature treatment.

considerations.text: Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport is 30 miles from the resort, a 35-minute trip.
The Troon North golf courses are off site, reached by complimentary shuttle.
WhataHotel notes the desert location may be too remote for some guests.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
